_comment: Copy to config/clients/<shortName>.local.json (gitignored). shortName becomes the mail alias local part (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens). tenantId is for the Graph sign-in: the tenant GUID or any verified domain. onmicrosoftDomain is the root domain set when the tenant was created (often not by us) and is where break-glass and admin accounts live; it is required unless tenantId already is that domain.
name: Contoso Dental

_optional.internalAlias: The alias added to clients@msp.example for this client. Defaults to msp.clientAliasPattern with {shortName} filled in; the console wizard asks you to confirm it.
_optional.support24x7: true when the client is on the 24x7 plan; selects which support phone number documents and templates show.
_optional.contactAddress: Address used for the hidden mail contact and IT@ list member in the client tenant. Defaults to internalAlias.
_optional.newUserDefaults: Used by lifecycle/Invoke-M365UserOnboarding.ps1. licenses are SKU part numbers (SPB = Business Premium, O365_BUSINESS_ESSENTIALS = Business Basic, SPE_E3 = E3); see reports/Get-M365LicenseReport.ps1 for the tenant's SKUs. groups are Entra security or Microsoft 365 groups: an exact display name that matches exactly one group, or the group's object id (use the id when two groups share a name; entra/Get-M365Group.ps1 lists them). Distribution lists and mail-enabled security groups go in distributionLists, as the list's primary address (preferred) or exact name. issueTemporaryAccessPass is only ever applied to an account the run creates.
